finding: FC10-F4: independent append-only fallback spool, dual-source replay/reconciliation, and non-gating dual-sink failure handling

Existing FC10-F3 test content in this shared file was preserved.

remaining_limits: When both filesystem sinks fail, no durable journal can be written. The caller receives sanitized primary and secondary exception classes, errno, safe frame data, and capture location, while stderr receives a generic marker; the business operation continues.
